logline: 花坡有聲音，樂也有聲音。
youtubeTitle: [playlist] QuietLY · 花坡晚樂 — Slow Mandarin Jazz

comics.en: The slope keeps its own kind of gold.
A bench for two, or for one long afternoon.
comics.zh: 一張椅，夠兩人，或一個長午。

comics.en: Stay until the river holds the red light.

tracks.lyrics:
[Instrumental intro — 35 seconds, no vocal]

[Verse 1]
花坡剛亮
風先笑一下
第一瓣落下
像把樂輕輕放在掌心
不響
卻夠溫暖

[Instrumental interlude — 20 seconds, no vocal]

[Refrain]
樂一點
再樂一點
不用盛大
也能明亮

[Verse 2]
淺草沒過鞋面
遠堤還在綠裏
我把腳步放慢
讓喜悅自己走路

[Poetry]
亂花漸欲迷人眼
淺草才能沒馬蹄
最愛湖東行不足
綠楊陰裏白沙堤

[English — after poetry]
Let the first petal teach the slope
No parade, no loud claim
Only the quiet work of becoming glad
Stay where the joy is light

[Instrumental break — 25 seconds, no vocal]

[Bridge — almost spoken]
也許樂
不是狂歡
只是終於
肯讓一天變輕

[Final refrain]
第一瓣還在
樂也還在
風繼續說
我不打斷

[Instrumental coda — 40 seconds, gradual fade, no vocal]

[Instrumental intro — 35 seconds, no vocal]

[English — opening]
Gold threads of bees write across the flowers
I do not need to chase them
Joy can pass by
And still leave the hillside warmer

[Instrumental — 10 seconds]

[Verse 1]
蜜蜂畫一條金線
從這朵到那朵
我不追
只站在坡上看樂經過

[Instrumental interlude — 20 seconds, no vocal]

[Refrain]
金線彎過
心也彎過
忙得很輕
像一種野外的樂

[Verse 2]
荷紅很遠
卻像提醒
顏色可以盛大
心情可以低調

[Poetry]
畢竟西湖六月中
風光不與四時同
接天蓮葉無窮碧
映日荷花別樣紅

[Instrumental break — 25 seconds, no vocal]

[Bridge — almost spoken]
不採蜜
也算參與
看一眼
就夠甜

[Final refrain]
蜂走遠了
金線還在空氣裏
樂也還在
像沒說完的甜

[Instrumental coda — 40 seconds, gradual fade, no vocal]

[Instrumental intro — 35 seconds, no vocal]

[Verse 1]
我笑一下不是表演
是坡上風真的剛好
細雨斜來
也不趕路

[Instrumental interlude — 20 seconds, no vocal]

[Refrain]
輕聲的樂
不是熱鬧
是把力氣
留給繼續走

[Verse 2]
白鷺一閃
桃花在水裏開會
沒有主席
卻有共識：今天可以樂

[Poetry]
西塞山前白鷺飛
桃花流水鱖魚肥
青箬笠
綠蓑衣
斜風細雨不須歸

[Instrumental break — 25 seconds, no vocal]

[Soft jazz-rap — restrained, no trap]
Soft joy, not a carnival
Rain can fall and still feel kind
I nod to the hillside work
And let the hurry go unused

[Final refrain]
笑過之後
風也鬆一點
樂在口袋裏
不發亮
卻夠用

[Instrumental coda — 40 seconds, gradual fade, no vocal]

[Instrumental intro — 35 seconds, no vocal]

[Verse 1]
[Female] 東風把線拉高
[Male] 西風把線放鬆
[Both] 兩紙鳶在坡上相遇
沒有誰贏

[Instrumental interlude — 20 seconds, no vocal]

[Refrain]
相遇就好
不必飛成同一高度
樂是並肩的線
不是互相糾纏

[English — between refrains]
Two kites meet and keep their strings
No one must disappear
Joy is the shared air
Between different flying

[Refrain — return]
相遇就好
不必飛成同一高度
樂是並肩的線
不是互相糾纏

[Verse 2]
楊柳醉了
我們也輕一點
誰也不急著落地
這就是野外的樂

[Poetry]
草長鶯飛二月天
拂堤楊柳醉春煙
兒童散學歸來早
忙趁東風放紙鳶

[Instrumental break — 25 seconds, no vocal]

[Bridge — almost spoken]
[Female] 你帶色彩
[Male] 我帶風聲
[Both] 天空接住全部

[Final refrain]
風走了
草還在搖
像記得
那一次溫柔的交叉

[Instrumental coda — 40 seconds, gradual fade, no vocal]

[Instrumental intro — 35 seconds, no vocal]

[Verse 1]
木椅不寬
卻夠兩人坐下
花坡在面前展開
像一張慢慢的樂譜

[Instrumental interlude — 20 seconds, no vocal]

[Refrain]
不急
不爭先
坐下
樂就自己來

[Verse 2]
相思不必急著採完
留幾枝給明天
今天先聽風
把句子吹完整

[Poetry]
紅豆生南國
春來發幾枝
願君多採擷
此物最相思

[Instrumental break — 25 seconds, no vocal]

[Bridge — almost spoken]
遠路可以等
椅子先溫暖
樂是允許
停一下

[Final refrain]
椅還暖
坡還亮
樂還在
像沒走完的小路

[English — closing]
No hurry on this wooden bench
The slope keeps writing soft notes
Joy arrives when we sit
And let the wind finish the phrase

[Instrumental coda — 40 seconds, gradual fade, no vocal]

[Instrumental intro — 35 seconds, no vocal]

[Verse 1]
三月的煙花
不是爆炸
是遠坡一層粉霧
把離別說得很輕

[English — after verse 1]
March flowers smoke across the hills
A farewell can still be glad
The sail grows small
And the sky grows kind

[Instrumental interlude — 20 seconds, no vocal]

[Refrain]
走也可以樂
留也可以樂
風把兩邊
都說成春天

[Verse 2]
帆影變小
天更寬
我把祝福
放進花香裏寄出

[Poetry]
故人西辭黃鶴樓
煙花三月下揚州
孤帆遠影碧空盡
唯見長江天際流

[Instrumental break — 25 seconds, no vocal]

[Bridge — almost spoken]
遠了不是失去
是讓眼睛休息
近處的花
繼續開

[Final refrain]
煙散了
花還在
樂像長江
慢慢流遠也不急

[Instrumental coda — 40 seconds, gradual fade, no vocal]

[Instrumental intro — 35 seconds, no vocal]

[Verse 1]
朝雨剛停
柳還青
我不是勸你醉
是勸你慢一點離開快樂

[Instrumental interlude — 20 seconds, no vocal]

[Refrain]
再盡一杯
不是告別儀式
是把樂
喝進身體裏帶走

[Verse 2]
陽關很遠
花坡很近
今天先把顏色
裝滿口袋

[Poetry]
渭城朝雨浥輕塵
客舍青青柳色新
勸君更盡一杯酒
西出陽關無故人

[Instrumental break — 25 seconds, no vocal]

[Soft jazz-rap — restrained, no trap]
One more cup of quiet joy
Not to forget the road
But to carry a warm hillside
Past the next gate

[Final refrain]
杯空了
柳還新
樂還在袖口
像沒揮完的手

[Instrumental coda — 40 seconds, gradual fade, no vocal]

[Instrumental intro — 35 seconds, no vocal]

[Verse 1]
船還沒走
歌聲先到
花坡像岸
把踏歌接住

[Instrumental interlude — 20 seconds, no vocal]

[Refrain]
情深
樂也深
不是比較
是互相映照

[Verse 2]
千尺水深
不如一句真
我把快樂
唱成可帶走的風

[Poetry]
李白乘舟將欲行
忽聞岸上踏歌聲
桃花潭水深千尺
不及汪倫送我情

[Instrumental break — 25 seconds, no vocal]

[Bridge — English nested]
A song arrives before the boat leaves
Friendship sounds like footsteps on the bank
Joy can be that deep
Without needing to measure it

[Spoken Mandarin tag]
情不必量

[Final refrain]
歌停了
花還開
樂像潭水
看起來靜
其實很深

[Instrumental coda — 40 seconds, gradual fade, no vocal]

[Instrumental intro — 35 seconds, no vocal]

[Verse 1]
[Female] 不是沒有聲音
[Male] 是樂拉得很長
[Both] 長到夠裝下
一整個黃昏的花坡

[Instrumental interlude — 20 seconds, no vocal]

[Refrain]
樂得久
比樂得響更難
慢慢認
慢慢亮

[Verse 2]
鐘聲很遠
也能變成安慰
遠方的夜
不妨礙近處的暖

[English — before poetry]
Before the poem, stay with this:
the longest joy is not the loudest
it stretches across the hillside
until evening itself feels held

[Poetry]
月落烏啼霜滿天
江楓漁火對愁眠
姑蘇城外寒山寺
夜半鐘聲到客船

[Instrumental break — 25 seconds, no vocal]

[Bridge — almost spoken]
[Both] 最長的樂
不是高潮
是一直還在

[Final refrain]
花暗了
樂還在延長
像一條溫柔的線
沒有急著打結

[Instrumental coda — 40 seconds, gradual fade, no vocal]

[Instrumental intro — 35 seconds, no vocal]

[Verse 1]
殘陽鋪過來
花坡一半暖
一半涼
樂就住在那條分界

[Instrumental interlude — 20 seconds, no vocal]

[Refrain]
半紅
也夠亮
不必整片燃燒
才叫快樂

[Verse 2]
露珠像小鏡子
把一天收好
我把笑容
也收成一顆

[Poetry]
一道殘陽鋪水中
半江瑟瑟半江紅
可憐九月初三夜
露似真珠月似弓

[English — after poetry]
Half the river turns red
Half stays cool
Joy can live on that edge
Without needing the whole sky to blaze

[Instrumental break — 25 seconds, no vocal]

[Bridge — almost spoken]
弓月很細
卻能掛住夜
樂也可以
細而有力

[Final refrain]
紅退了
露還亮
樂還掛著
像沒鬆開的弓

[Instrumental coda — 40 seconds, gradual fade, no vocal]

[Instrumental intro — 35 seconds, no vocal]

[Verse 1]
無風也是一種樂
鏡子不用急著磨亮
遠山像青螺
放在安靜的盤子裏

[Instrumental interlude — 20 seconds, no vocal]

[Refrain]
相和
也是樂
不是表演
是彼此剛剛好

[Verse 2]
花坡遠望
也能變成湖光
我把心放平
顏色自己來

[Poetry]
湖光秋月兩相和
潭面無風鏡未磨
遙望洞庭山水翠
白銀盤裏一青螺

[Instrumental break — 25 seconds, no vocal]

[Soft jazz-rap — restrained, no trap]
Silver disk, green spiral
Joy can be this still
No wind required
Only two things agreeing softly

[Final refrain]
盤還在
螺還青
樂像無風
卻把一切托住

[Instrumental coda — 40 seconds, gradual fade, no vocal]

[Instrumental intro — 35 seconds, no vocal]

[English — opening]
Seen from the side, a ridge
Seen from below, a peak
Joy changes shape with walking
And still belongs to the same hill

[Instrumental — 10 seconds]

[Verse 1]
橫看是花海
側看是小路
樂也一樣
換個角度就換一種笑

[Instrumental interlude — 20 seconds, no vocal]

[Refrain]
各不同
也同在
樂不是單一面
是整座坡的名字

[Verse 2]
身在其中
反而看不清
走遠一步
才發現自己剛快樂過

[Poetry]
橫看成嶺側成峰
遠近高低各不同
不識廬山真面目
只緣身在此山中

[Instrumental break — 25 seconds, no vocal]

[Bridge — almost spoken]
真面目
也許就是
允許不完整的看見

[Final refrain]
我走遠了
坡還在
樂還在
像沒被說完的山

[Instrumental coda — 40 seconds, gradual fade, no vocal]

[Instrumental intro — 35 seconds, no vocal]

[Verse 1]
荷蓋收了
菊還立著
花坡進入
一種沉靜的樂

[Instrumental interlude — 20 seconds, no vocal]

[Refrain]
好景
不在最吵的季節
在顏色
學會收斂的時候

[Verse 2]
橙黃橘綠
像兩種成熟的笑
我把它們記下來
當冬天的乾糧

[Poetry]
荷盡已無擎雨蓋
菊殘猶有傲霜枝
一年好景君須記
最是橙黃橘綠時

[Instrumental break — 25 seconds, no vocal]

[Bridge — almost spoken]
殘也是一種完整
樂懂得這個
就不急著盛開

[Final refrain]
霜來了
枝還傲
樂還甜
像沒摘完的橘

[English — closing]
Remember the orange-and-green hour
When flowers finish loudly
And joy becomes quieter fruit
Worth carrying home

[Instrumental coda — 40 seconds, gradual fade, no vocal]

[Instrumental intro — 35 seconds, no vocal]

[Verse 1]
花瓣落地
不是結束
是樂換一種工作
去護住下一輪

[English — after verse 1]
Fallen red is not a cold goodbye
It turns into spring mud
And keeps feeding the next bloom
Joy can work underground

[Instrumental interlude — 20 seconds, no vocal]

[Refrain]
落也樂
護也樂
循環很安靜
卻很有力量

[Verse 2]
天涯可以遠
泥土很近
我把告別
變成養分

[Poetry]
浩蕩離愁白日斜
吟鞭東指即天涯
落紅不是無情物
化作春泥更護花

[Instrumental break — 25 seconds, no vocal]

[Bridge — almost spoken]
無情的樣子
常常最有情
樂懂這個
就不慌

[Final refrain]
泥還暖
芽還藏
樂還在地下
輕輕護著

[Instrumental coda — 40 seconds, gradual fade, no vocal]

[Instrumental intro — 35 seconds, no vocal]

[Verse 1]
雪可以紛紛
樂也可以紛紛
不是否認冷
是承認路上仍有人

[Instrumental interlude — 20 seconds, no vocal]

[Refrain]
莫愁
前路有光
花坡只是起點
把勇氣點亮

[Verse 2]
知己不一定同走
也可以同在心裏
我把名字
借給風傳一下

[Poetry]
千里黃雲白日曛
北風吹雁雪紛紛
莫愁前路無知己
天下誰人不識君

[Instrumental break — 25 seconds, no vocal]

[Soft jazz-rap — restrained, no trap]
Do not fear the empty road
Joy can travel in company
Even when the snow keeps falling
Someone still knows your name

[Final refrain]
雲還黃
雁還飛
樂還跟著
像沒說完的保重

[Instrumental coda — 40 seconds, gradual fade, no vocal]

[Instrumental intro — 35 seconds, no vocal]

[Verse 1]
東邊有太陽
西邊在下雨
花坡站在中間
樂也學會雙面

[Instrumental interlude — 20 seconds, no vocal]

[Refrain]
無晴
卻有晴
樂常常這樣
說不清卻真實

[English — between refrains]
Sun on one side, rain on the other
Joy can hold both weathers
And still keep singing
As if the slope understood

[Refrain — return]
無晴
卻有晴
樂常常這樣
說不清卻真實

[Verse 2]
歌聲從遠處來
我不必看清臉
聽見就夠
讓心情起一點浪

[Poetry]
楊柳青青江水平
聞郎江上唱歌聲
東邊日出西邊雨
道是無晴卻有晴

[Instrumental break — 25 seconds, no vocal]

[Bridge — almost spoken]
矛盾也可以美
像濕亮的葉子
又冷又暖

[Final refrain]
雨停了
陽還在
樂還笑著
像一句雙關的晴

[Instrumental coda — 40 seconds, gradual fade, no vocal]

[Instrumental intro — 35 seconds, no vocal]

[Verse 1]
[Female] 記得那種紅
[Male] 記得那種藍
[Both] 花坡今晚
把它們溫柔地複習

[Instrumental interlude — 20 seconds, no vocal]

[Refrain]
舊曾諳
也是樂
不是懷舊病
是把好顏色帶回身體

[Verse 2]
火不必燒人
綠不必解釋
我們並肩看
一天自己開花

[English — before poetry]
Before the poem returns south:
river flowers redder than fire
river water greener than dye
Joy can be a remembered color
Still warm on this hillside

[Poetry]
江南好
風景舊曾諳
日出江花紅勝火
春來江水綠如藍

[Instrumental break — 25 seconds, no vocal]

[Bridge — almost spoken]
[Both] 江南很遠
樂很近
近在呼吸裏

[Final refrain]
紅退成暮色
藍沉成安靜
樂還留著
像舊風景的新一次

[Instrumental coda — 40 seconds, gradual fade, no vocal]

[Instrumental intro — 35 seconds, no vocal]

[Verse 1]
三兩枝就夠
不必整片喧鬧
樂常常是
剛剛好的稀疏

[Instrumental interlude — 20 seconds, no vocal]

[Refrain]
水暖
鴨先知
我也先知
腳下的坡開始軟

[Verse 2]
蘆芽還短
未來還藏
我把期待
放得很輕

[Poetry]
竹外桃花三兩枝
春江水暖鴨先知
蔞蒿滿地蘆芽短
正是河豚欲上時

[English — after poetry]
A few peach branches are enough
Ducks know the water first
Joy often arrives that way
Quiet, early, and already true

[Instrumental break — 25 seconds, no vocal]

[Bridge — almost spoken]
先知不是炫耀
是身體先高興
再告訴嘴巴

[Final refrain]
枝還少
暖還在
樂還先到
像鴨劃開的一條線

[Instrumental coda — 40 seconds, gradual fade, no vocal]

[Instrumental intro — 35 seconds, no vocal]

[Verse 1]
[Female] 花坡還沒散場
[Male] 樂也還沒說完
[Both] 我們站在暮色裏
繼續聽

[Instrumental interlude — 20 seconds, no vocal]

[Refrain]
樂不是結局
是一直在聽
聽風
聽顏色慢慢收

[Verse 2]
輕舟過山
像一天過完
快樂可以快
也可以留下餘溫

[Poetry]
朝辭白帝彩雲間
千里江陵一日還
兩岸猿聲啼不住
輕舟已過萬重山

[Instrumental break — 25 seconds, no vocal]

[Bridge — almost spoken]
[Both] 萬重山之後
還有坡
還有一點未熄的亮

[Final refrain]
雲散了
坡還在
樂還在耳邊
像沒停的輕舟

[English — closing]
Still listening for joy
Not as a finale
But as a soft current
That keeps the hillside awake

[Instrumental coda — 40 seconds, gradual fade, no vocal]
